note: Terms used in card text as [[id]] or [[id|shown text]]. Each has the term and a kid-friendly definition in English and Traditional Chinese. tests/glossary.test.mjs fails if card text uses an id that isn't here; the build report lists missing and unused terms.

def.en: How high a place is above the sea.
def.zh: 一個地方比海平面高多少。

def.en: A bony branch that grows on a deer's head. Deer shed their antlers and grow new ones every year.
def.zh: 長在鹿頭上的骨質分叉，鹿每年都會脫落舊角、長出新角。

def.en: A forest of trees with wide, flat leaves instead of needles.
def.zh: 由葉子寬大扁平（不是針狀）的樹組成的森林。

def.en: To eat leaves, twigs and shoots from bushes and trees.
def.zh: 吃灌木和樹上的葉子、嫩枝和嫩芽。

def.en: A hole or tunnel an animal digs in the ground to live or hide in.
def.zh: 動物在地下挖的洞或隧道，用來住或躲藏。

def.en: The group of mammals that includes cats, dogs, bears and civets. Many of them eat meat, but not all.
def.zh: 包括貓、狗、熊和果子狸等的哺乳動物類群，很多會吃肉，但不是全部。

def.en: A hole inside a tree trunk, used by some birds and animals as a nest.
def.zh: 樹幹裡的洞，有些鳥和動物會用來當巢。

def.en: All the eggs a bird lays in one nest at one time.
def.zh: 鳥在同一個巢裡、一次生下的所有蛋。

def.en: A silk case a caterpillar spins around itself before it changes into a moth.
def.zh: 幼蟲變成蛾之前，用絲把自己包起來的外殼。

def.en: A forest of trees with needle-like leaves and cones, such as pines.
def.zh: 由葉子像針、會結毬果的樹（例如松樹）組成的森林。

def.en: On the IUCN Red List, the most serious danger level before an animal disappears from the wild.
def.zh: 在IUCN紅色名錄中，野外滅絕前最危險的等級。

def.en: A state in which an animal's body almost completely stops, so it can survive very harsh conditions.
def.zh: 動物的身體幾乎完全停止運作，讓牠能撐過非常惡劣環境的狀態。

def.en: When a fertilised egg waits for a while before it starts growing into a baby.
def.zh: 受精卵先等一段時間，才開始長成寶寶。

def.en: A sheltered hiding place where an animal rests or has its babies.
def.zh: 動物休息或生寶寶的隱蔽地方。

def.en: In Taiwan's wildlife law, the highest level of protection, for animals at risk of disappearing forever.
def.zh: 臺灣野生動物保育法中最高的保護等級，用在有可能永遠消失的動物。

def.en: Found naturally in only one place in the world.
def.zh: 在全世界只有某個地方才自然生長的物種。

def.en: Gone forever: no living animals of that kind are left anywhere.
def.zh: 永遠消失了：世界上再也沒有任何一隻活著。

def.en: The remains or traces of a living thing from long ago, preserved in rock.
def.zh: 很久以前的生物留下、保存在岩石裡的遺骸或痕跡。

def.en: The time a baby animal grows inside its mother before it is born.
def.zh: 動物寶寶出生前，在媽媽肚子裡長大的時間。

def.en: To float through the air without flapping, like a paper plane.
def.zh: 不用拍翅膀，像紙飛機一樣在空中飄行。

def.en: To eat grass and other low plants growing on the ground.
def.zh: 吃地上的草和其他矮小的植物。

def.en: A young bird that helps its parents raise the next chicks instead of breeding itself.
def.zh: 自己先不繁殖，幫爸爸媽媽養育弟弟妹妹的年輕鳥。

def.en: An animal that eats only plants.
def.zh: 只吃植物的動物。

def.en: To go into a long, deep sleep through the winter to save energy.
def.zh: 在冬天長時間沉睡，節省體力。

def.en: The whole area an animal moves around in to find food and shelter.
def.zh: 動物平常找食物、休息時會走動的整片區域。

def.en: The time an egg is kept warm until the baby inside hatches.
def.zh: 蛋被保持溫暖，直到裡面的寶寶孵出來的時間。

def.en: An animal that eats mostly insects.
def.zh: 主要吃昆蟲的動物。

def.en: On the IUCN Red List, a very high risk of disappearing from the wild.
def.zh: 在IUCN紅色名錄中，在野外消失的風險非常高。

def.en: A tough material that hair, nails, horns and scales are made of.
def.zh: 一種堅韌的材料，頭髮、指甲、角和鱗片都是由它組成的。

def.en: A fish that stays in fresh water all its life instead of going to the sea.
def.zh: 一輩子都待在淡水裡、不會游到大海的魚。

def.en: On the IUCN Red List, an animal that is not in danger right now.
def.zh: 在IUCN紅色名錄中，目前沒有滅絕危險的動物。

def.en: A metal trap that snaps shut on an animal's leg or paw.
def.zh: 會夾住動物腳的金屬陷阱。

def.en: All the babies born to a mother at one time.
def.zh: 媽媽一次生下的所有寶寶。

def.en: Trees and shrubs that grow in salty water along tropical coasts.
def.zh: 生長在熱帶海岸鹹水中的樹木和灌木。

def.en: The oldest female, who leads her family group.
def.zh: 帶領家族的最年長母親。

def.en: On the IUCN Red List, an animal that could soon be in danger.
def.zh: 在IUCN紅色名錄中，很快可能面臨危險的動物。

def.en: Active at night and resting during the day.
def.zh: 晚上活動，白天休息。

def.en: An animal that eats both plants and other animals.
def.zh: 植物和動物都吃的動物。

def.en: Laying eggs that hatch outside the mother's body.
def.zh: 生下蛋，讓寶寶在媽媽身體外面孵出來。

def.en: Hunting or catching wild animals when the law says you mustn't.
def.zh: 違反法律去打獵或捕捉野生動物。

def.en: An animal that hunts and eats other animals.
def.zh: 會獵捕並吃掉其他動物的動物。

def.en: An animal that is hunted and eaten by another animal.
def.zh: 被其他動物獵捕來吃的動物。

def.en: A family group of lions.
def.zh: 一起生活的獅子家族。

def.en: In Taiwan, a wild animal the law protects more strongly, in one of three levels: endangered, rare and valuable, or other conservation-deserving.
def.zh: 在臺灣，法律特別保護的野生動物，分成三級：瀕臨絕種、珍貴稀有、其他應予保育。

def.en: A thick, green forest where it rains a lot all year.
def.zh: 一年到頭雨量很多、茂密翠綠的森林。

def.en: A worldwide list made by scientists that shows how much danger each species is in.
def.zh: 科學家整理的全球名單，說明每種生物面臨多大的危險。

def.en: An animal killed by a car or other vehicle on the road.
def.zh: 在路上被汽車或其他車輛撞死的動物。

def.en: To rest or sleep somewhere, like a bat hanging in a tree.
def.zh: 在某個地方休息或睡覺，例如蝙蝠倒掛在樹上。

def.en: A wide, warm grassland with only a few trees.
def.zh: 溫暖、寬廣、只有少數樹木的草原。

def.en: An animal that eats the remains of animals that are already dead.
def.zh: 會吃已經死掉的動物屍體的動物。

def.en: A grown-up male gorilla, named for the silver hair on his back, who leads the group.
def.zh: 成年公大猩猩，因背上有銀白色的毛而得名，是群體的領袖。

def.en: Living alone instead of in a group.
def.zh: 自己生活，不和同伴成群。

def.en: A group within a species that lives in one area and looks a little different from the others.
def.zh: 同一個物種中，住在某個地區、外表有點不同的一群。

def.en: An area an animal claims as its own and defends from others.
def.zh: 動物當成自己地盤、會趕走其他同類的區域。

def.en: A group of monkeys that live together.
def.zh: 一起生活的一群猴子。

def.en: A poison some animals inject with a bite or sting.
def.zh: 有些動物咬人或叮人時注入的毒。

def.en: On the IUCN Red List, an animal at high risk of becoming endangered.
def.zh: 在IUCN紅色名錄中，很有可能變得瀕危的動物。
